increment: G3 native race rules and penalties
limits: Penalties are verified with authored positions, not by a car driving itself into an infringement.
The rules are not connected to a running race yet; that is the authoritative race runtime in the next increment.
Nothing consumes the accumulated penalty time yet: RacePitController already accepts one for service timing, but wiring it belongs to the race runtime.

RaceLapTiming still applies the lap-validity half itself for existing single-car sessions; a runtime calling RaceRules.apply should pass no validity rules to the timing so the shared section is not applied twice.
The original dereferences its penalty queue head when the rule flags say a penalty was served; the port reports an empty queue as nothing to clear rather than reading it.
Aalborg / 155-DTM pinned fixtures; the pit rules depend on each track's pit flags and a track without pits exercises none of them.
The original reads the previous tick's published lap time, so a runtime must pass the published value rather than a freshly computed one.
priority: Gameplay; foliage and new graphical work deferred
scope: Semantic ReRaceRules port: lap-time elimination, wall-hit and corner-cut invalidation, race corner-cut time penalty, penalty queue, pit-lane rule state machine and pit speed limit, compared against the original routine with authored positions

verification.gating: Release suite gated on the three-digit total line with no runtime-failure, Fatal, failed-case or signal markers
verification.oracle: ref_world_progress_init with ref_world_race_configure, ref_world_race_public_speed and ref_world_race_car_state
